title: Product inventory
hints: Multiply its number of O–H bonds by three.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Each water molecule has two O–H bonds, so the coefficient three gives six.
statement:
How many O–H bonds are formed when the balanced product side includes $\ce{3H2O(g)}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: Two bonds per molecule times three molecules.
This counts one water molecule only.
Three atoms per molecule does not mean three bonds.
